name: City of London: parks
goal: This page lists public parks in London, Ontario with their addresses and features. Pick up to 6 parks from the list that have features worth a short visit. For each give its name, its address and its listed features. Skip anything marked closed. Return JSON in the form {"places": [{"name": ..., "address": ..., "about": ...}]}.

name: Tourism London: hiking trails
goal: This page lists guides to hiking trails and natural areas in London, Ontario. List up to 6 trails or natural areas named on it. For each give its name and a one-sentence description taken from the page. Return JSON in the form {"places": [{"name": ..., "about": ...}]}.

name: Upper Thames River Conservation Authority: London's natural areas
goal: This page lists the Environmentally Significant Areas (ESAs) in London, Ontario that are open to the public, each with a brochure or map. List up to 6 of them by name. For each, say in one sentence what the page offers for it and note any closure the page mentions. Return JSON in the form {"places": [{"name": ..., "about": ...}]}.

name: City of London: events
goal: This page is the City of London, Ontario events calendar. Find up to 5 upcoming public events that people can attend in person, such as festivals, guided walks, markets or lightings. Skip council and committee meetings. For each, give the name of the venue or park where it takes place, and the event's title and date. If no venue is named for an event, skip it. Return JSON in the form {"places": [{"name": <venue or park>, "about": <event title and date>}]}.

name: Tourism London: events this week
goal: This page lists events in London, Ontario. Look at the events happening this week. Find up to 5 that take place outdoors or in a public venue such as a park, a market or a square. For each, give the name of the venue, and the event's title and date. Return JSON in the form {"places": [{"name": <venue>, "about": <event title and date>}]}.
